description: For every parameter \(R\), structural recursion on a supplied native cut-free certificate \(p:\Gamma\Rightarrow A\) constructs a cut-free certificate \(\mathcal T_R(p):\Gamma^{[R]}\Rightarrow F_R(A)\). Atomic identity expands to identity of the translated atom \(a\lor R\), falsum-left uses parameter explosion, native negation-left becomes implication-left, and native negation-right becomes implication-right.
